item.title: Attention Residuals
item.description:
📝 Block AttnRes Full AttnRes is straightforward but requires O(Ld) memory at scale. Block AttnRes partitions layers into N blocks, accumulates within each block via standard residuals, and applies attention only over block-level representations. Block AttnRes matches the loss of a baseline trained with 1.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/Attention-Residuals

item.title: Meme Buildings
item.description:
📝 Nevertheless, I’ll call them meme buildings because it best describes the ripples these buildings cause. They’re not well-known buildings or those buildings some people like to call iconic, and they’re definitely not must-see buildings for the architectural tourist. Meme buildings are spared this fate because they’re just known for what they are.
🔗 Read more: https://misfitsarchitecture.com/2026/03/15/meme-buildings/
